name: retro-pink-car-summer-beauty

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic 1950s-inspired summer fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman reclining across a vintage pink convertible on white sand.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with wind-swept free-flowing hair, high-fashion expression, natural skin texture, coral-toned lips, and focused gaze. She wears a vintage-inspired bubblegum-pink one-piece swimsuit with ruched bodice and matching fabric belt with circular buckle.
composition_elements: Low-angle 35mm wide shot looking upward, capturing subject and environment.
Subject reclines elegantly across the trunk and side panel of a classic pink convertible.
One arm bends with head resting lightly on forearm; other arm drapes naturally over the hip.
White sand beach, expansive turquoise sky, soft wispy clouds, and distant tropical greenery.

prompt.technical_specs: 35mm wide-angle lens, f/5.6 deep focus, 8K photorealistic RAW look, crisp car, swimsuit, sand, and sky texture, Hasselblad-inspired photography, no text or watermark.
